## About

A Push from the east, 18 frames long, on the cut at 4 s: the incoming sunset pushes the dunes
off to the left. Motion blur at 25 smears both pictures along the move, so the push reads as one
fast sweep. The thumbnail is the middle of the push, with the blurred seam between the two scenes
in the middle of the frame.
